explanation: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Tasks' }) is a case-insensitive substring match. Once the list loads and the 'All tasks' subhead renders, it resolves to two headings (h1 'Tasks' and h2 'All tasks'), a strict mode violation. Before the load only the h1 existed, which is why it looked flaky.
fix: Use { name: 'Tasks', exact: true } so only the h1 matches.
